unload car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 adult 2

unload car1 adult 2

</plan>
COST: 120

The plan rescues the 3 elderly and 3 adults at Myagang temple in two round trips (80 minutes). It defers the 2 adults at Tadi farm (40). Reaching Tadi farm costs a 44-minute detour from Myagang temple, which is more than the 40-minute penalty for deferring them. Rescuing everyone would cost 124, so this plan is cheaper.
